Do you want to own Identity systems that major AWS and Stores services depends on to exist and the layers that make that data consumable by every service that needs it? The LDAP Core and Switchboard teams are part of the AFSS Identity organization within Amazon's Foundational Security Services. We hold the records of engineering identity at Amazon, and we make that record reachable through modern access pattern.
  
  
LDAP Core operates the canonical engineering identity directory: the 389DS LDAP fleet, its global replication topology, and the regionalized architecture (REGAL) we are building to replace it by 2027. Switchboard builds the routing, temporal, analytical, and control layers that surround that directory the Read Proxy, Time Machine, the Identity Data Lake, and GSAM, the control plane for millions of system accounts across Amazon's engineering data planes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

* Own 389DS software lifecycle: upgrade train, master fleet replication, schema management across commercial, GovCloud, ADC, China, and MVP

* Lead schema evolution discipline: document every attribute, analyze consumer impact end-to-end before every change
* Architect and evolve the LDAP Read Proxy: schema-routed access, expansion to BRASS and additional backends, transparent to existing callers
* Own GSAM as the system-account control plane across LDAP, POSIX, ANT : lifecycle management, credential rotation, ANT auto-provisioning, and the path to passwordless system accounts

**Job Description**
Are you a curious and motivated engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art autonomous aircraft? Are you eager to apply your engineering fundamentals to real hardware while learning from experienced teammates? Do you want to work alongside mission-driven and values-focused people? Shield AI may be the place for you.
  
  
As a Mechanical Engineer on the Mechanisms team, you will contribute to the design, development, and integration of mechanical systems for Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft. Your work may include a focus on gearbox development and integration, including gears, shafts, bearings, housings, lubrication systems, and related interfaces.

**What You'll Do**

* Support the design and integration of mechanical mechanisms for autonomous aircraft, potentially including gearboxes and other power-transmission systems
* Create and update 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, bills of materials, and interface documentation
* Complete defined design tasks involving component sizing, material selection, tolerance analysis, and mechanical packaging
* Perform foundational structural, kinematic, and machine-design calculations with guidance from senior engineers
* Assist with preliminary finite element analysis and document assumptions, methods, and results
* Support the selection and integration of gears, bearings, shafts, splines, seals, fasteners, and lubrication components
* Help build, inspect, test, and iterate prototype hardware for functionality, performance, and reliability
* Support pre-production builds, aircraft integration, and ground and flight testing
* Investigate well-defined technical issues, document findings, and contribute to root-cause and corrective-action activities
* Collaborate with mechanical, propulsion, electrical, avionics, flight-controls, manufacturing, and test teams
* Follow established engineering, configuration-management, and product-release processes
* Develop plans for assigned tasks, communicate progress and risks, and incorporate feedback from teammates

**Required Qualifications**

* 0-1 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience
* Understanding of fundamental mechanical engineering principles, including statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, materials science, and machine design
* Academic, internship, student-team, research, or project experience using 3D CAD software
* Ability to create or interpret basic engineering drawings
* Familiarity with dimensional tolerancing and GD&T fundamentals
* Ability to perform foundational engineering calculations and clearly document assumptions and results
* Hands-on interest in designing, building, integrating, or testing mechanical hardware
* Strong problem-solving, organization, documentation, and communication skills
* Ability to complete well-defined engineering tasks with guidance from peers and managers
* Ability to collaborate effectively, accept feedback, and work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
* A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others
* Ability to obtain an S//SAR-level security clearance is desired

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, student-team, research, or project experience involving aircraft, UAVs, robotics, automotive systems, or other mechanical products
* Coursework or project experience related to gearboxes, gearing, bearings, shafts, splines, seals, lubrication, or rotating machinery
* Familiarity with gear geometry, gear-train calculations, bearing selection, or mechanical power transmission
* Experience with NX or a similar production CAD platform
* Exposure to tolerance stack-ups, mechanical fits, and GD&T application
* Exposure to finite element analysis, including static, modal, buckling, or fatigue analysis
* Familiarity with MATLAB, Python, or other engineering analysis tools
* Hands-on machine-shop, mechanic, fabrication, assembly, or inspection experience through professional, academic, or hobby activities
* Exposure to FMEA, design of experiments, root-cause analysis, or reliability testing
* Familiarity with additive manufacturing, machining, casting, forging, or other mechanical manufacturing processes
* Exposure to RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810, structural testing, vibration testing, or mechanism testing
* Ability to thrive in startup, R&D, or defense-innovation environments

As a Software Engineer in MBO, you'll build the technology that powers Microsoft's business. From the creation of new commercial offers and consumption meters to the systems that track usage, generate insights, enable billing, and measure business outcomes, you'll help shape the end-to-end lifecycle that connects innovation to customer value.
  
  
Our engineers operate at the intersection of software, data, AI, and commerce, building intelligent platforms that power some of Microsoft's most critical business processes. **Responsibilities**
The USDS Platform and Community Integrity (PaCI) team is the architectural backbone of TikTok's Risk & Integrity in the US. We drive end-to-end integrity for TikTok and its expanding ecosystem, including Lemon8 and emerging affiliate platforms, by leveraging localized US data and state-of-the-art AI/LLM capabilities.
  
  
Our mission is to deliver AI-driven algorithmic solutions that detect and neutralize systemic threats across critical domains: from Account Integrity, Feed, and Social to TikTok Live, Local Services, and User Growth. We architect the core ML infrastructure and risk intelligence that protect our billion-user ecosystem from adversarial threats.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
- Global Ecosystem Governance: Lead the algorithmic architecture and governance for TikTok US across key domains, including account integrity, incentive abuse, content safety, and financial risk, ensuring a fair and secure ecosystem for a billion-user community.
  
- Universal Representation Modeling: Build high-precision, risk representation models leveraging massive heterogeneous data (video, live streams, audio, behavior sequences, and social graphs) to enable cross-scenario risk perception.
  
- Dynamic Adversarial Defense: Research and counter global adversarial threats (e.g., large-scale automated attacks, AIGC harmful content). Architect self-evolving defense systems that maintain robustness and resilience against rapid tactic shifts and data drift.
  
- Intelligent Decision-making: Drive the integration of Generative AI and Multimodal technologies into the risk lifecycle. Leverage LLMs and deep learning models to solve complex adjudication and interpretability challenges, balancing precision with automated, large-scale enforcement.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  
- Solid foundation in Machine Learning; proficient in applying Transformer and GNN architectures to solve large-scale integrity challenges with social graph and behavior sequence data. Experience designing model evaluation systems that balance technical performance with product goals.
  
- Strong engineering and coding skills. Proficient in at least one language among Python, C++, or Go; familiar with distributed computing (e.g., Spark, Flink) and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch).
  
- A passion for building world-class risk infrastructure and the ability to communicate effectively in a global, cross-cultural environment.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Agentic AI Experience: Hands-on experience building LLM-based Agents capable of task planning, tool-use, or closed-loop autonomous decision-making.
  
- LLM Security & Alignment: Experience in LLM Post-training or Fine-tuning (e.g., SFT, RLVR, RLHF) to optimize models for specific risk domains like fraud intent recognition or malicious redirection.
  
- Multimodal Expertise: Proven track record in video understanding or multimodal representation; ability to integrate visual, audio, and textual features to solve complex behavioral modeling challenges.
  
- Industry Vision: Experience in Integrity, Anti-Abuse, Safety, or Trustworthy AI at a large-scale internet platform.

**Responsibilities**
Team introduction:
  
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) of the AML (Applied Machine Learning) team combines system engineering and the art of machine learning to develop and run massively distributed AI/ML systems like recommendation or LLM in the United States and around the world.
  
  
In the SRE team, you'll have the opportunity to sharpen your expertise in coding, performance analysis, and large-scale system operation, and get heavily involved in the process of hardware/capacity decision-making. SRE ensures that critical machine learning systems have the highest level of availability, as well as creating highly automated systems and pipelines.
  
  
Join us and you'll have the chance to shape the future of AML systems and make a real, tangible impact on TikTok users.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
- Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant systems.
  
- Monitor and analyze system performance, identifying and resolving issues before causing user impact.
  
- Develop and maintain automated monitoring, alerting, and incident response systems.
  
- Collaborate closely with software engineering teams to ensure that applications are designed with reliability, scalability, and performance in mind.
  
- Implement and maintain security best practices and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
  
- Participate in on-call rotations and respond to issues and incidents within and outside of normal business hours.
  
- Conduct root cause analysis of incidents, hold post-mortem reviews with stakeholders, and implement preventative measures to minimize the risk of similar incidents occurring in the future.

Minimum Qualifications:
  
- Expertise in analyzing and troubleshooting Linux-based distributed systems.
  
- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent years of experience in a SRE or software engineering role.
  
- Experience programming with at least one commonly used language (C, C++, Python, Go).
  
- Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.
  
- Competent knowledge of relational database systems.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Ability to design and maintain large-scale systems.
  
- Strong understanding of code optimization and routine task automation.
  
- Proficiency in at least one machine learning framework: TensorFlow, PyTorch, MXNet or PaddlePaddle.

**Job Summary**
We invest heavily in new talent because fresh perspectives help us innovate and elevate what’s possible. As AI transforms how organizations use and manage their data, NetApp is helping shape the next generation of intelligent data infrastructure across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to bring forward new ideas, take ownership of meaningful work, and drive results alongside a team that succeeds together, while receiving the mentorship, resources, and feedback you need to grow.
  
  
As a Software Engineer Intern on one of our Cloud Storage teams, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and improve cloud-based software and services. Depending on your team and project assignment, you may contribute to areas such as cloud storage, distributed systems, backend services, APIs and microservices, automation, data management, service reliability, and performance.
  
  
You’ll gain hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle while learning how scalable and reliable cloud services are designed, built, tested, deployed, and operated.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, test, and enhance cloud-based software and services.
* Build or contribute to backend services, APIs, and microservices.
* Work with cloud-native technologies such as containers and Kubernetes.
* Integrate cloud services, APIs, databases, and platform components.
* Troubleshoot software defects, service failures, and performance issues.
* Build automated tests, tools, and workflows that improve software quality and engineering efficiency.
* Participate across the software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing and deployment.
* Collaborate across teams to solve complex technical problems and improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of cloud services.

**Example Project Work**
Intern projects vary based on team priorities and business needs and may include:
  
  

* Cloud Storage Services: Develop or enhance software that helps customers store, manage, protect, and access data in cloud environments.
* APIs & Microservices: Build or enhance APIs and backend services used to interact with cloud resources.
* Cloud-Native Development: Develop containerized services using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Automation & CI/CD: Build automated testing, deployment, or development workflows.
* Distributed Systems & Reliability: Develop and test scalable cloud services with a focus on reliability, availability, and performance.
* Storage & System Integration: Develop integrations between storage services, APIs, protocols, and cloud platforms.

Job Requirements
  
  

* Programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, C++, C#, Java, or Python through coursework, projects, research, internships, or other experience.
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Linux or Unix environments.
* Exposure to cloud computing concepts or platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Interest in APIs, backend services, distributed systems, or cloud-native development.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to learn and apply new technologies.
* Coursework, projects, or experience with technologies such as REST APIs, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, databases, CI/CD, automated testing, or cloud platforms is a plus.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with exposure through coursework, projects, or hands-on use considered a plus.

You don’t need experience in every technology listed above. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, technical problem-solving skills, and the ability to learn.
  
  
**Additional Details**

* Job Posting Info: This is a pipeline position used to fill internship opportunities across multiple engineering teams, and recruiting will continue as individual teams identify project and hiring needs.
* Program Details: This is a 10–12 week summer internship, with start dates in May or June 2027.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Must be enrolled in an educational or professional program through the summer of 2027.
* Candidates pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field are encouraged to apply.

* 1+ years of experience with Palantir including hands-on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Foundry, AIP, Maven
* 1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions
* 1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud) and common platform services (storage, compute, IAM, networking)
* Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments
* Data engineering experience with Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, data modeling or ML/data science background feature engineering, experimentation or model evaluation
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and prompt management
* Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems via APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures
* Experience operating within hybrid onshore/offshore teams

**Description**
The AmSec Endpoint Security Capabilities and Prevention Engineering team build and operate first and third party services for the monitoring and response to malicious activity on the Amazon internal devices. We collect data from all parts of Amazon's environment worldwide.
  
  
We seek a Software Development Engineer who is excited about solving challenging problems by developing our own solutions that protect Amazon and our customer data. Our challenges are broad and deep -- we build flexible, secure, scalable, high-performance and robust tools and services. These services enable our security engineers and analysts to detect and respond to malicious activity on our infrastructure. In Amazon Security we operate multiple large scale data query platforms to allow security engineers to detect anomalies and facilitate threat hunting. You will work with a group of engineers to operate these services to the highest operational level while building new tools and services to improve the customer experience and make it easier/faster/cheaper for the customer to get what they need.
  
  
In AmSec, we obsess over our customers, and their trust is our first priority. Trust is earned by building a highly respected security team to tackle new challenges at a large scale. In this role, you will deliver high quality, scalable products that are deployed to our internal services around the world. You will collaborate with product owners and customers to deliver the best features, using resources and technologies efficiently. You will work with stakeholders to define solutions that scale and satisfy a wide variety of security needs. You will also assess risks, anticipate bottlenecks, and balance business needs against technical constraints to maximize business benefit.
  
  
On-Call Responsibility
  
  
This position involves on-call responsibilities. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, implement and maintain platform services and features using AWS to build highly scalable solutions.
* Automate deployments, upgrades and system changes to ensure continous operations
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand their use cases and build solutions to automate their workflows.
* Enable customers to automate security tasks and track success metrics using our tooling
* Participate in on-call operations to ensure system reliability and continuity across the company
* Identify opportunities to enhance skills in software development, cloud computing and security

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why Amazon Security?
  
  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
  
  
Training & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

We are building a closed-loop discovery engine: AI models that propose hypotheses, high-throughput experiments that test them against living systems, and a feedback cycle that turns experimental results back into better models. Robots are how that loop closes in the physical world.
  
  
This is a software engineering role with a robotics mandate. Most of the work is building systems: data pipelines, services, interfaces, evaluation harnesses, and the control and learning stack that drives our manipulation station. **Description**
Training and running large AI models takes enormous amounts of expensive accelerated compute, and most of it sits idle. Across the industry, a large share of GPU capacity is paid for but never does useful work because jobs cannot find it, cannot share it, or cannot see it and use it efficiently. We build the services that closes that gap.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build the systems that put idle or inefficiently used GPUs to work. You will design and build distributed backend services that let organizations pool capacity across many clusters and accounts, route it to the workloads that need it most, and see exactly how it is being used. This is deep systems work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure, and it directly changes how much value customers get from every GPU they pay for.
  
  
You will own services end to end, from design through launch and operation in production, and your work will ship to some of the largest AI compute customers in the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, build, and operate distributed backend services that manage and share accelerated compute across multiple clusters and accounts.
  
  
Build scheduling and capacity-sharing capabilities that move compute to the highest-priority workloads and reclaim it when priorities change.
  
  
Build zero-touch usage and guidance systems that collect, aggregate, and report how compute is consumed, at scale and in near real time.
  
  
Own your services in production: define operational metrics, respond to issues, and continuously improve reliability, latency, and cost.
  
  
Write clear design documents, participate in design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar for the team.
  
  
Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to turn customer problems into shipped features.
  
  
Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of ownership, quality, and customer focus.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Most days start with a short team stand-up, then it is mostly building. You might design a service that lets one cluster borrow idle capacity from another, then write it up for a design review where the team pokes holes in it before any code is written. Hard problems get their own deep-dive whiteboard session. Other days lean toward operations, chasing down why a workload did not get the capacity it should have. You will not be handed fully specified tasks; you will have the independence to help decide what to build, then build it.
  
  
**About The Team**
We help customers get the most out of the accelerated compute they pay for. Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: make sure every accelerator a customer pays for is doing useful work, and make that easy to see and control. Cost reduction is one important part of that, but the bigger idea is the engine that delivers compute to the workloads that need it most, in as little time as possible.
  
  
Our customers run some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world, and they feel the impact of our work directly in how much they can do with their infrastructure. We care about depth, we own our work end to end, and we build in the open where we can.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Job Description**
**The Team**
Cola is part of GM’s autonomous vehicle effort, focused on helping teams discover, understand, and curate high-value data from large-scale real-world sensor streams. The team sits at the intersection of machine learning, data infrastructure, and developer productivity, building systems that make it easier to search for important scenarios, prepare training-ready data, and support fast iteration across perception and evaluation workflows.
  
  
Our goal is to make world understanding scalable, practical, and cost efficient for embodied AI systems. We believe the next generation of autonomy and robotics depends not only on stronger models, but also on better infrastructure for turning massive volumes of multimodal data into reusable signals, searchable artifacts, and high-quality evaluation loops. That means building systems that can operate at industrial scale while preserving the flexibility to adapt quickly to new questions, new edge cases, and new model capabilities.
  
  
A core idea behind how we work is EMWU, or Efficient Multi-Tier World Understanding. At a high level, EMWU is a cost-aware approach that first performs the cheapest reusable work, such as detection, featurization, and retrieval, and then applies deeper reasoning only where it adds meaningful value. This operating model reflects how Cola engineers think: build durable intermediate artifacts, design for scale from the start, and balance quality, speed, and cost instead of optimizing any one of them in isolation.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on machine learning engineer to help build the data processing, featurization, and inference foundations that power scalable world understanding. This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable working on machine learning systems, production infrastructure, and evaluation loops, and who enjoys turning ambiguous problems into practical, reliable solutions.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and productionize data processing and featurization pipelines for large-scale multimodal data
* Improve inference frameworks for computer vision and multimodal models, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and operational simplicity
* Drive scalability and cost efficiency across the end-to-end pipeline, including compute utilization, throughput, storage, and query performance
* Work closely with partners across machine learning, infrastructure, and evaluation to deliver systems that support both rapid experimentation and production use
* Develop and refine evaluation methods for model quality, retrieval quality, and system-level performance
* Help shape technical direction through strong execution, thoughtful tradeoff analysis, and clear engineering judgment

**Description**
**Position Summary**
R3 is seeking an AI Engineer to design, implement, secure, and drive adoption of enterprise AI solutions. This role will have a strong focus on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, and Anthropic Claude, combining hands-on AI engineering with cybersecurity, data protection, governance, and user enablement.
  
  
The ideal candidate understands that successful AI transformation requires more than deploying technology. This individual will help ensure AI solutions are secure, practical, adopted by users, and deliver measurable business value. The AI Engineer will work across technology, security, compliance, Professional Services, and business teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into scalable solutions for R3 and its customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI Engineering & Solutions**

* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude.
* Build AI agents, assistants, automations, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions grounded in enterprise data.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure, APIs, and other enterprise platforms.
* Develop and optimize prompts, agent instructions, knowledge sources, workflows, and AI orchestration.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their practical application within R3 and customer environments.

**AI Security, Data Protection & Governance**

* Understand and address the cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance risks introduced by generative AI.
* Design solutions that protect confidential, sensitive, regulated, and customer data from inappropriate access, disclosure, or use.
* Apply security and governance controls using technologies such as Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), sensitivity labels, and Conditional Access.
* Help establish AI governance standards covering approved platforms, acceptable use, data handling, identity, access, third-party AI services, and responsible AI.
* Understand and apply relevant frameworks and requirements such as CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 where appropriate.

**User Adoption & Training**

* Drive adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other approved AI technologies across business teams.
* Develop and deliver role-based AI training, workshops, demonstrations, office hours, and hands-on enablement sessions.
* Create reusable prompt libraries, use-case playbooks, quick-reference materials, and responsible AI guidance.
* Help employees understand what information can and cannot be safely shared with AI platforms.
* Identify high-value use cases by working directly with business teams to understand workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish and support AI champions and power-user communities to accelerate adoption and share best practices.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to continuously improve AI solutions and training.

**Business Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish baseline measurements and KPIs for significant AI initiatives before deployment.
* Measure adoption, productivity, quality, security, and business outcomes following implementation.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing AI solutions based on usage, user feedback, security requirements, and technological advancements.
* Translate technical AI capabilities into clear business outcomes for customers, users, and executive leadership.

**How Success Will Be Measured**
Success in this role will be measured across four key areas:
  
  

* Build Deliver reliable, scalable AI solutions that solve meaningful business problems and can be operationalized across R3 and customer environments.
* Protect Ensure AI solutions maintain appropriate security, identity, privacy, compliance, and data-protection controls while reducing the risk of inappropriate AI usage or data exposure.
* Adopt Increase active usage and employee proficiency through effective training, AI champions, practical use cases, and ongoing enablement. Measures may include active users, repeat usage, training participation, user satisfaction, and departmental adoption.
* Prove Demonstrate measurable business value through outcomes such as hours saved, reduced manual effort, faster service delivery, improved response quality, increased employee productivity, improved customer experience, or new revenue opportunities.

**The Right Candidate**
The successful AI Engineer will be equally comfortable building an AI agent, evaluating its security implications, teaching employees how to use it, and demonstrating whether it is delivering measurable value.
  
  
The right individual will combine technical curiosity with a strong security mindset and a passion for helping people embrace new technology. They will play a key role in enabling R3 and its customers to adopt AI responsibly, securely, and in ways that produce meaningful business results.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Qualifications**

* Experience designing, developing, or implementing enterprise AI, cloud, automation, or software solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio, with experience integrating AI into Microsoft 365 environments.
* Experience with Anthropic Claude and modern large language models.
* Working knowledge of Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, APIs, and enterprise data integration.
* Knowledge of Microsoft security and compliance technologies, particularly Purview, Defender, Entra ID, DLP, and Information Protection.
* Understanding of AI security risks including data leakage, oversharing, excessive permissions, prompt injection, sensitive information exposure, and inappropriate use of public AI tools.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, JavaScript, C#, Power Platform, or similar technologies is preferred.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to lead training and confidently engage with customers, employees, technical teams, and executive leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft 365 security and compliance solutions
* Experience supporting regulated or compliance-focused environments, including CMMC and the Defense Industrial Base (DIB)
* Consulting or Professional Services experience
* Experience developing AI adoption, governance, or organizational change-management programs

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
  
  
**Job Description**
Shield AI is on a mission to build the world’s best aircraft—and we’re looking for a Harness Design Engineer to help power that vision. In this high-impact, high-ownership role, you’ll be designing complex wire harnesses and cable assemblies that are the nervous system of X-BAT, our next-generation autonomous UAV platform.
  
  
Your expertise in harness design won’t just support the mission—it will enable it. From concept to deployment, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring reliability, precision, and performance in the field, where failure is not an option.
  
  
If you’re passionate about cutting-edge aerospace technology and want to build systems that make a real-world difference, this is your chance to make your mark—on the ground and in the skies.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design wire harnesses and cable assemblies for X-BAT and supporting ground equipment
* Collaborate with electrical engineering to define connector selection, current/voltage requirements, shielding, and other design aspects
* Perform electrical, mechanical, and environmental analysis for harness reliability
* Prototype and test harnesses in dynamic, mission-critical environments
* Collaborate with avionics, systems, supply chain, and manufacturing teams for integration
* Lead technicians in building, testing, and debugging various parts of the EWIS system

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering
* 0-2 years working with wire harness designs for automotive, aerospace, or robotics. Professional, personal, or club experience is acceptable
* 3D CAD modeling tool experience, such as NX or CATIA
* Knowledge of GD&T best practices, tolerance stack-ups, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards
* Experience with electrical schematics and connector selection
* Hands-on experience with harness fabrication or testing
* Ability to work independently in fast-paced, cross-functional teams
* A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others
* Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

**About The Team**
The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. Pushing the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, and efficiency improvements to propel our science.
  
  
The Search team sits within Foundations, building agentic search by co-designing model–system interfaces with the core search stack (serving, indexing, retrieval) to translate model intent into reliable, real-world actions. Operating at the frontier of AI and information retrieval, the team develops large-scale systems that transform and index vast corpora, enabling models to reason over global knowledge and act dependably. In close partnership with researchers, we rapidly bring modeling breakthroughs into production and redefine how intelligent systems discover, retrieve, and synthesize information at planetary scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Software Engineer focused on building and scaling retrieval systems. You’ll work with a team of researchers and engineers to develop infrastructure that enables models to retrieve and act on the right information at the right time. This includes designing and operating indexing systems, retrieval pipelines, and serving layers.
  
  
This work supports retrieval across OpenAI products and research, with direct impact on system performance, reliability, and scale.
